local local_class = newclass('LilithTowerNobodyController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = LilithTowerNobody @
		Comment = 아무것도 아닌 할아버지 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.pooled_bullets = nil
	self.pooled_bullet_size = 6

	self.get_custom_sprite = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite') end

	self.get_old_man = function() return get_character('nobody_old_man') end
	self.get_man = function() return get_character('nobody_man') end
	self.get_woman = function() return get_character('nobody_woman') end

	self.get_grocery_fo = function(num)
		if num == 3 then
			return get_field_object('nobody_grocery_gum')
		elseif num == 4 then
			return get_field_object('nobody_grocery_coffee')
		end

		return get_field_object('nobody_grocery_' .. num)
	end

	self.got_gum = false
	self.got_coffee = false

	self.grocery_item_ids = {
		20020,
		20036,
		20428,
		20429
	}
	self.grocery_items = {}

	self.stage_1_name = 'lilithtower_1_1'
	self.stage_2_name = 'lilithtower_1_2'
	self.stage_3_name = 'lilithtower_1_3'

	self.exclusive_on = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerNobodyPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerNobodySection1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerNobodySection2')
	}
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- 섹션 2, 스테이지 3에서만 로드함
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1
			and self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false and stage.Name == self.stage_3_name then
		quest_util.load_pool_resource('custom_sprite')

		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		local custom_atlas

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
					custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
					custom_atlas:Initialize()
				end)

		self.pooled_bullet = {}
		for i = 1, self.pooled_bullet_size do
			self.pooled_bullet[i] = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
			local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
			bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
			bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
			bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
			bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

			bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'virus_bullet_2.png'
			bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
		end
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local grocery_index = -1
	for i = 1, #self.grocery_item_ids do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_grocery_fo(i)) then
			grocery_index = i
			break
		end
	end

	if grocery_index > 0 then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0
				and self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false then
			-- 껌과 커피는 섹션 1에서 처리함
			if grocery_index <= (#self.grocery_item_ids - 2) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_grocery, self, grocery_index)
				return true
			end
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_grocery, self, grocery_index)
			return true
		end

		return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_start_event(e)
	if e.Key == 'detected_by_terrorist' then
		if (self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete) == false
				and stage.Name == self.stage_3_name and self.exclusive_on == false then
			self.exclusive_on = true
			if e.Fade then
				self:exclusive_on_immediately()
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_on_routine, self))
			end

			return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_exclusive_quest_end_event(e)
	if e.Key == 'detected_by_terrorist' and self.exclusive_on then
		self.exclusive_on = false

		if e.Fade then
			self:exclusive_off_immediately()
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.exclusive_off_routine, self))
		end

		return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name then
		for index, item_id in pairs(self.grocery_item_ids) do
			-- 커피와 풍선껌은 섹션 2 이상일 때 삭제함
			if not (index > 2 and self.quest_progress ~= nil
					and (self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 0 or self.quest_progress.IsComplete)) then
				local interactable_fo = self.get_grocery_fo(index)
				local target_pos = field:GetMarker('nobody_grocery_' .. index).position
				interactable_fo.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos)

				local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
					itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					pos = target_pos, sprscale = (index == 4 and 0.4 or 1)
				})
				table.insert(self.grocery_items, item)
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_2_name then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			-- TODO : 세이프 하우스 세팅
			self.get_old_man().ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			self.get_man().ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			self.get_woman().ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

			character_util.set_emotion(self.get_woman(), {name = 'love'})
			character_util.set_emotion(self.get_man(), {name = 'smile'})
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.stage_3_name then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			-- TODO : 세이프 하우스 세팅
			self.get_old_man().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			self.get_man().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			self.get_woman().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_1_name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
			self.pooled_bullet[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.grocery_item_ids do
		if self.grocery_items[i] ~= nil then
			self.grocery_items[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end
	self.grocery_items = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

function local_class:interact_grocery(index)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'lilith_tower_nobody_grocery_' .. index})
end

function local_class:exclusive_on_immediately()
	local npcs = {
		self.get_old_man(),
		self.get_man(),
		self.get_woman(),
	}

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:exclusive_off_immediately()
	local npcs = {
		self.get_old_man(),
		self.get_man(),
		self.get_woman(),
	}

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
end

function local_class:exclusive_on_routine()
	local npcs = {
		self.get_old_man(),
		self.get_man(),
		self.get_woman(),
	}

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:exclusive_off_routine()
	local npcs = {
		self.get_old_man(),
		self.get_man(),
		self.get_woman(),
	}

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:directing_terrorist_attack(terrorist_list)
	self.is_directing_terrorist = true
	self.is_play_jingak_sfx = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.terrorist_attack_loop, self,
			terrorist_list[1], 0, true))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.terrorist_attack_loop, self,
			terrorist_list[2], 0.15, false))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.terrorist_attack_loop, self,
			terrorist_list[3], 0.2, false))
end

function local_class:terrorist_attack_loop(fo, wait_duration, is_shake)
	wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
	if fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then return end
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'jingak', scale = 2 })
	while self.is_directing_terrorist do
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		if is_shake then
			for i = 1, 6 do
				local shutter = get_field_object('police_officer_shutter_' .. i)
				shutter:Shake(0.015, 0.15)
			end
		end
		if self.is_play_jingak_sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_01')
		end
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(fo.Position + vector(0.5, 0.3, 0))
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'disabled')
end

	self.quest_id = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.is_directing_terrorist = false
	self.is_play_jingak_sfx = false

--[[QuestAttribute
      Type = controller @
      QuestName =  @
      Comment = 리리스 타워 이력서 이벤트 컨트롤러 @
]]

-- 필요한 객체 정의
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.get_resume_man = function() return get_character('resume_man')  end
	self.get_buddy_dog = function() return get_character('buddy_dog')  end

	self.get_terrorist = function(num) return get_character('resume_terrorist_' .. num) end

	self.star_piece_name = 'resume_star_piece'
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('resume_star_piece') end

	-- 드랍된 이력서 아이템
	self.drop_item_resume = nil
end

-- 아래 on_load_resource_routine
function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerResumeSection1')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'LilithTowerResumePostSection')
end

-- 객체, 리소스 셋팅
function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- 이벤트가 완료된 상태라면 재시작 시...
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		-- NPC 등등의 오브젝트 활성화, 인터렉션 기타 체크...
		character_util.set_active_state(self.get_resume_man(), 'disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(self.get_buddy_dog(), 'disabled')

		-- 테러리스트 비활성화
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local terrorist = self.get_terrorist(i)
			if terrorist ~= nil then
				character_util.set_active_state(terrorist, 'disabled')
			end
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_field_object('cctv_1'), { 'cctv_1', 'cctv_off' }))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(get_field_object('cctv_2'), { 'cctv_2', 'cctv_off' }))

		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.star_piece_name) and star_piece ~= nil then
			star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
		end

		-- 이력서 이벤트 엔딩 방 문 열림
		local door = get_field_object('resume_event_zone_door')
		if door ~= nil then
			local animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			animator:Play('open', -1)
			door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

		local paper = get_field_object('resume_paper')

		if paper ~= nil then
			paper.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	local lilith_tower_main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(258)
	if lilith_tower_main_quest ~= nil and lilith_tower_main_quest.InnerProgress >= 5 then
		local start_door = get_field_object('resume_event_start_zone_door')
		if start_door ~= nil then
			local animator = start_door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			animator:Play('open', -1)
			start_door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

-- 스테이지 시작 전 로드 중 호출되는 함수
function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end


--end region

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end


	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_id = nil
	self.sections = nil
end



return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if ( zone_name == 'xlog_magiccircle_1' or zone_name == 'xlog_magiccircle_2') and self.warp_magiccircle == false then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_magiccircle_out, self)
		return true
	end

	if zone_name == 'xlog_magiccircle_3' and self.warp_magiccircle == false then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_magiccircle_record, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 가속 상태로 점프타일에 접근하면 연출 점프
	if zone_name == 'xlog_jump_tile' and self.is_jumping == false then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.accel_jump, self))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.normal_jump, self))
		end
		return true
	end
end

		get_field_object('xlog_accel_1').Position = vector(-19, 0, 161)
		return true
	end

	return false

	local updater = CS.Oak.ChapterProgressManager.Updater(coco_stage.ChapterCode)

	coroutine.yield(updater)

	local stage_progress = CS.Oak.ChapterProgressManager.Instance:GetStageProgress(coco_stage)
	self.has_card_key = stage_progress:GetCustomData(1)
end

	self.magiccircle_2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle'):Instantiate(
			self.get_xlog_record_room_out_pos())
	self.magiccircle_2.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

	self.magiccircle_3 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle'):Instantiate(
			self.get_xlog_elevator_51b_pos())
	self.magiccircle_3.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
end

function local_class:normal_jump()
	local jump_tile = get_field_object('xlog_jump_tile')
	local dir = 13 * unity_class.vector3.right + 11 * unity_class.vector3.up
	local jump_info = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()

	self.is_jumping = true

	-- 연출 중에 폭탄에 죽지 않도록 무적 처리
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)

	jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('on')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('off')
		self.is_jumping = false
		character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, false)
	end))

	jump_info.jumper = user_party.Leader
	jump_info.speed = dir.magnitude
	jump_info.direction = dir.normalized
	jump_info.jumpStartPos = user_party.Leader.Position
	jump_info.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jump_info.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	local cmd = CS.Oak.JumpCommand.Create(jump_info)
	command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)
end

-- 가속 타일 연출 점프
function local_class:accel_jump()
	local push_block = get_field_object('xlog_push_block')
	local jump_tile = get_field_object('xlog_jump_tile')
	local cliff_2 = get_field_object('xlog_cliff_2')
	local is_hit_block = false

	self.is_jumping = true

	-- 연출 중에 폭탄에 죽지 않도록 무적 처리
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)

	if push_block.Position.x < 1.5 then
		cliff_2.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.cliff_interactable = cliff_2.Interactable
		get_field_object('xlog_cliff_1').Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		cliff_2.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		is_hit_block = true
	end

	jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('on')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('off')
		self.is_jumping = false
		character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, false)
	end))

	local jump_info = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()

	local right_magnitude = 9.1

	if is_hit_block then
		right_magnitude = 8.7
	end
	local dir = right_magnitude * unity_class.vector3.right + 12 * unity_class.vector3.up

	jump_info.jumper = user_party.Leader
	jump_info.speed = dir.magnitude
	jump_info.direction = dir.normalized
	jump_info.jumpStartPos = user_party.Leader.Position
	jump_info.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jump_info.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	local cmd = CS.Oak.JumpCommand.Create(jump_info)
	command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)
	wait_for_sec(1.45)

	if is_hit_block then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_elevator, self)
	end
end

-- 엘리베이터 입장 연출
function local_class:enter_elevator()
	get_field_object('xlog_cliff_1').Interactable = self.cliff_interactable
	get_field_object('xlog_cliff_2').Interactable = self.cliff_interactable

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.3,0,0))
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' }, {name = 'damaged'})

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'linear', true, vector(-2, 0, 0), nil, nil,
			nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
			CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party.Leader.Owner, user_party.Leader, knock_back_info, user_party.Leader.Position)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_shadow(user_party[i], false)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise'})
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()

			character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'damaged' })
			local fall_duration = 0.5
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party[i], 360 * 2, fall_duration + 0.5)
			user_party[i].SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, fall_duration + 0.5)

			local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party[i].Position)
			local end_pos = start_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

			local fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 19.6, start_pos.y, 0)
			fall_calculator:ScaleTime(0.7)

			local current_y = start_pos.y

			local time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < fall_duration do
				local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

				time_passed = time_passed + dt
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / (fall_duration + 0.5))

				fall_calculator:Proceed(dt)
				current_y = fall_calculator:GetDistance()

				local current_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

				user_party[i].Position = current_xz + current_y * unity_class.vector3.up

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party[i], 0, 0)
		end))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	end

	if user_progress:IsStageOpened('substage_7_6') and self.quest_progress ~= nil and
			self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then

	-- 티탄왕국 서브스테이지에서의 활동을 전부 끝냈다면 재입장할떄 NPC들 전부 비활성화
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 1 and stage.Name == 'substage_2_8' then
		stage.CharacterManager:ChangeCharacterActiveStates(CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral, CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled);
		-- 스테이지 클리어가 가능하도록 클리어 플래그 설치
		local clear_flag = get_field_object('clear_flag')
		clear_flag.Position = field:GetMarker('clear_flag_pos').position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)
	end

		if stage.Name == "titantavern_1_3" then
			get_character("maid").ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

			clear_flag.Position = field:GetMarker('clear_flag_pos').position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)
		end
		return
	end

	if stage.Name == "teatans_1_4" then
		coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_pre())
	elseif stage.Name == "substage_2_8" then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0then
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_1())
		end

		else

		end

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 then
			coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting_4())
		end
	end

	return false
end

end

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	end

	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_5_name then

		-- 상호작용 이벤트 처리
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
			local delivery_staff = get_character("Staff_5")
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(delivery_staff, e.Target) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.interact_to_delivery_staff, self))
			end
		end

		-- 스테이지 시작 이벤트 처리
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
			if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 15 then
				stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs(CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral, CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled)
			else
				local delivery_staff = get_character('Staff_5')
				delivery_staff.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

				--  16섹션의 인트로 이벤트를 이미 봤다면 마지막 촬영지에서 시작하도록 함.
				local is_seen_intro = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 15 or self.quest_progress:GetCustomState('seen_stage5_intro') ~= -1
				if is_seen_intro then
					local marker_names = {
						'check1',
						'check1_1',
						'check1_2',
						'check1_3',
						'check1_4'
					}
					local launch_marker_name
					if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 20 then
						launch_marker_name = marker_names[1]
					else
						launch_marker_name = marker_names[self.quest_progress.InnerProgress - 14]
					end

					local start_section_num = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 20 and 16 or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress + 1

					self:teleport_delivery_staff(start_section_num)

					local start_section = self.sections[start_section_num]

					-- 로드해야할 리소스가 있다면 불러줌.
					if start_section.load_film_site_resource ~= nil then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
								util.cs_generator(start_section.load_film_site_resource))
					end

					lua_helper.call_nullable(start_section, 'film_site_setting', start_section, self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > start_section_num - 1)

					if start_section.entry_event ~= nil then
						local func = function()
							local marker = field:GetMarker(launch_marker_name)
							camera_util.move_async(marker.position, 0.05)
							party_util.position_party(marker.position, marker.direction, 'arc')
							coroutine.yield()

							screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
							screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

							start_section:entry_event()
						end
						sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(func)
					else
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
								util.cs_generator(stage_launch_util.default_launch_with_marker_name, launch_marker_name))
					end

					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:interact_to_delivery_staff()
	local all_film_over = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 19
	local staff = get_character("Staff_5")

	local film_site_grid_names = {
		'prologue',
		'invader_bombing',
		'wire',
		'black_magician',
		'champion_sword'
	}

	local delivery_markers = {
		field:GetMarker('check1'),
		field:GetMarker('check1_1'),
		field:GetMarker('check1_2'),
		field:GetMarker('check1_3'),
		field:GetMarker('check1_4')
	}

	local current_grid_idx
	for i, grid_name in ipairs(film_site_grid_names) do
		if field:IsInCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, grid_name) then
			current_grid_idx = i
		end
	end

	local has_next_film_site
	if all_film_over then
		has_next_film_site = current_grid_idx < #film_site_grid_names
	else
		has_next_film_site = self.current_section.film_over or current_grid_idx < self.quest_progress.InnerProgress - 14
	end

	local has_prev_film_site = current_grid_idx > 1

	-- 다음이나 이전 촬영장으로 갈수있다면 이동 선택지 보여줌.
	if has_next_film_site or has_prev_film_site then

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.align_to_target(staff, staff.Direction)

		local wait = true
		local choose_next_film_site = false
		local choose_prev_film_site = false
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

		if has_next_film_site then
			-- 다음 촬영장으로 간다.
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString('movie5_move_next_film_site'),
				Callback = function ()
					wait = false
					choose_next_film_site = true
				end})
		end

		if has_prev_film_site then
			-- 이전 촬영장으로 간다.
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString('movie5_move_prev_film_site'),
				Callback = function ()
					wait = false
					choose_prev_film_site = true
				end})
		end

		-- 아무것도 하지않는다.
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('movie5_do_nothing'),
			Callback = function ()
				wait = false
			end})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party_leader, branches)

		while wait do coroutine.yield() end

		local delivery_film_site_idx
		local move_branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		wait = true
		if choose_next_film_site then
			if all_film_over then
				for i = current_grid_idx + 1, #film_site_grid_names do
					move_branches:Add({
						Text = game_string:GetString('movie5_' .. film_site_grid_names[i] .. '_scene'),
						Callback = function()
							wait = false
							delivery_film_site_idx = i
						end })
				end
			else
				local available_sections = self.current_section.film_over and (self.quest_progress.InnerProgress + 1) - 14 or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress - 14
				for i = current_grid_idx + 1, available_sections do
					move_branches:Add({
						Text = game_string:GetString('movie5_' .. film_site_grid_names[i] .. '_scene'),
						Callback = function()
							wait = false
							delivery_film_site_idx = i
						end })
				end
			end
		elseif choose_prev_film_site then
			for i = current_grid_idx - 1, 1, -1 do
				move_branches:Add({
					Text = game_string:GetString('movie5_' .. film_site_grid_names[i] .. '_scene'),
					Callback = function()
						wait = false
						delivery_film_site_idx = i
					end })
			end
		else
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			party_util.reset_controllers()
			return
		end

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party_leader, move_branches)

		while wait do coroutine.yield() end

		local current_section_number = 15 + current_grid_idx
		local target_section_number = 15 + delivery_film_site_idx
		self:stage5_player_delivery_process(current_section_number, target_section_number,
				self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < target_section_number - 1, delivery_markers[delivery_film_site_idx])

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	else
		local oneline_process = function()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(staff)

			-- 촬영이 곧 시작 됩니다! 배우분들 서둘러 주세요!!
			character_util.look_at(staff, user_party.Leader)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(staff, { key = 'movie_s16_54' })
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(oneline_process))
	end
end

-- 이동하려는 섹션 넘버에 따락 배달 스태프를 이동시켜주는 함수
function local_class:teleport_delivery_staff(section_number)
	local film_site_grid_names = {
		'prologue',
		'invader_bombing',
		'wire',
		'black_magician',
		'champion_sword'
	}

	local target_site = film_site_grid_names[section_number - 15]
	local marker = field:GetMarker(target_site .. '_delivery')
	local staff = get_character('Staff_5')
	staff.Position = marker.position
	staff.Direction = marker.direction
end

-- 스테이지5 스태프가 플레이어를 배달해주는 프로세스
function local_class:stage5_player_delivery_process(current_section_num, target_section_num, is_progress, delivery_marker)
	local current_section = self.sections[current_section_num]
	local target_section = self.sections[target_section_num]

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	lua_helper.call_nullable(current_section, 'film_site_dispose', current_section)

	lua_helper.call_nullable(target_section, 'load_film_site_resource', target_section)

	if is_progress then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self)
	end

	party_util.position_party(delivery_marker.position, delivery_marker.direction)

	self:teleport_delivery_staff(target_section_num)

	-- 촬영장 세팅함수가 있다면 실행
	local retake = target_section.film_over or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > target_section_num - 1
	lua_helper.call_nullable(target_section, 'film_site_setting', target_section, retake)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	-- 섹션을 넘겼고 진입 이벤트가 있는 섹션이라면 실행
	if is_progress and target_section.entry_event ~= nil then
		target_section:entry_event()
	end
end

end

function local_class:move_effect_bezier_curve(transform, spline_list, cycle)
	local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()

	local curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear

	if #spline_list == 3 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
	elseif #spline_list == 4 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
	end

	local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 1, #spline_list do
		list:Add(spline_list[i])
	end

	calculator:Add(list, cycle, curve_type)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < cycle do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local cur_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

		calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition

		transform.position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:move_effect(transform, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos = transform.position

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:shake_3d_object_routine(fo, duration, magnitude)
	magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(magnitude, 1)

	local req_id = self.shake_req_id[fo]
	local origin_pos = fo.Position
	local pos_list = {
		vector(-0.02, 0, 0),
		vector(-0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0),
		vector(0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0.02, 0, 0)
	}

	local cur_idx = 3
	local dif = 1
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if req_id ~= self.shake_req_id[fo] then break end

		cur_idx = cur_idx + dif
		if cur_idx > 5 then
			cur_idx = 5
			dif = -1
		elseif cur_idx < 1 then
			cur_idx = 1
			dif = 1
		end

		fo.Position = origin_pos + (pos_list[cur_idx] * magnitude)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = origin_pos
end

--- 3D 오브젝트를 흔들어줌.
--- @param fo any 흔들 물체
--- @param duration number 흔들릴 시간
--- @param magnitude number 좌우로 흔들리는 크기
function local_class:shake_3d_object(fo, duration, magnitude)
	if self.shake_req_id[fo] == nil then
		self.shake_req_id[fo] = 0
	end
	self.shake_req_id[fo] = self.shake_req_id[fo] + 1

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.shake_3d_object_routine, self, fo, duration, magnitude))
end

--- 3D 오브젝트를 흔드는 것을 멈춰줌.
--- @param fo any 멈출 물체
function local_class:stop_shake_3d_object(fo)
	if self.shake_req_id[fo] ~= nil then
		self.shake_req_id[fo] = self.shake_req_id[fo] + 1
	end
end

-- 차량 피봇이 모서리에 있고 회전이 적용 안된 AABB로 검사하는것 보다 타이밍으로 맞추는것이 적절해보여 충돌체크 x

function local_class:set_default_quest_marker()
	local exit_name = {
		'exit_nightmare_demonworld_2',
		'exit_nightmare_demonworld_3',
		'exit_nightmare_demonworld_4',
		'exit_nightmare_demonworld_5',
		'exit_nightmare_demonworld_6',
		'clear_flag'
	}

	local idx = string.sub(stage.Name, 22, 23)

	local exit = get_field_object(exit_name[tonumber(idx)])
	if exit ~= nil then

		self.use_default_quest_marker = true

		-- 5스테이지 지하로 -> 4스테이지 지하로로 이동하는 것인지 체크
		-- 파티가 시작할 지점을 읽어오는 것으로 확인
		local marker_obj = nil
		if stage.Name == 'nightmare_demonworld_4' then
			if not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(stage.StartWaypoint)  then
				marker_obj = get_field_object(self.stage_4_underground_outside_2_interact_name)
				-- 해당 오브젝트를 못 찾았을 경우 기존 사용 오브젝트로 변경
				if marker_obj == nil then
					marker_obj = get_field_object(self.stage_4_underground_inside_1_interact_name)
				end
			else
				marker_obj = get_field_object(self.stage_4_underground_inside_1_interact_name)
			end
		else
			marker_obj = exit
		end

		quest_marker_util.show(self,
				self.default_quest_marker_name,
				marker_obj, true)
		self.default_quest_marker_target = exit
		return
	end
end

function local_class:get_inside_exit_interact_object_name(object_name)
	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(object_name) then
		return nil
	end
	local pair_object_name = self.in_exit_interact_object_name[object_name]
	if pair_object_name ~= nil then
		return pair_object_name
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_outside_exit_interact_object_name(object_name)
	if string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(object_name) then
		return nil
	end

	local pair_object_name = self.out_exit_interact_object_name[object_name]
	if pair_object_name ~= nil then
		return pair_object_name
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:change_main_quest_marker(quest_marker_point)
	local marker_point = nil
	if lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_point, CS.Oak.FieldObject) then
		marker_point = quest_marker_point
	elseif not string_helper.is_nil_or_empty(quest_marker_point) then
		marker_point = get_field_object(quest_marker_point)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if marker_point ~= nil then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.default_quest_marker_name)
		quest_marker_util.show(self,
				self.default_quest_marker_name,
				marker_point)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	local flesh_count = 30
	self.fleshes = {}
	for i = 1, flesh_count do
		local rad = unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value

		local target_x = unity_class.mathf.Cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(2, 8)
		local target_z = unity_class.mathf.Sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(2, 8)

			itemid = flesh_id[i % 4 + 1], notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.7, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

		local customSprite = self.fleshes[i].SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		customSprite.TintColor = unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1})
		customSprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.wriggle, self, self.fleshes[i], i % 2 == 1))
	end
end

-- 살점이 꿈틀거리는 연출
function local_class:wriggle(flesh, is_x)

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.5, 1)

	for _ = 1, 10 do

		local start_scale
		local end_scale

		if is_x then
			start_scale = flesh.SpriteTransform.localScale.x
		else
			start_scale = flesh.SpriteTransform.localScale.y
		end

		local rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.05, 0.15)

		if start_scale <= 0.7 then
			end_scale = 0.7 + rand
		else
			end_scale = 0.7 - rand
		end

		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

			local cur_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)

			local result_scale

			if is_x then
				result_scale = vector(cur_scale, 0.7, 0.7)
			else
				result_scale = vector(0.7, cur_scale, 0.7)
			end

			flesh.SpriteTransform.localScale = result_scale
			flesh.ShadowTransform.localScale = result_scale

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		time_passed = 0

	end
end

-- 서서히 살점이 사라지는 연출
function local_class:fade_sprite(sprite)

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1

	local custom_sprite = sprite.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local custom_alpha = 1

	local shadow_sprite = sprite.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_alpha = shadow_sprite.Alpha

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01( 1 - (time_passed / duration))
		custom_sprite.Alpha = custom_alpha * alpha_progress
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress

		custom_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 모든 살점을 페이드한다.
function local_class:fade_all_flesh()
	for i = 1, #self.fleshes do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.fade_sprite, self, self.fleshes[i]))
	end
end

-- 실제로 살점을 없애준다.
function local_class:remove_all_flesh()
	for i = 1, #self.fleshes do
		self.fleshes[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.fleshes = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		consumed = self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		consumed = self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	if consumed == true then
		return true
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local sifu = self.get_sifu()
	local iron_sand_pot = self.get_iron_sand_pot()
	local merchant = self.get_merchant()
	local female = self.get_female()
	local diamond = self.get_diamond()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sifu) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_sifu, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, iron_sand_pot) and not self.current_section.is_pot_into_iron_sand_pot then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intract_iron_sand_pot, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, merchant) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_merchant, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, female) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_female, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, diamond) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_diamond, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	-- Jungpa_male, fire, idle, down, 이 곳은 강철 같은 주먹을 위해 철사장을 수련하는 곳!

	character_util.set_emotion(sifu, { name = 'burning' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sifu, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_10' })

function local_class:intract_iron_sand_pot()
	local iron_sand_pot = self.get_iron_sand_pot()

	party_util.align_to_target(iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'arc')

	-- 선택지
	-- 온도를 올린다. / 아무것도 하지 않는다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_dosa_betting_12', 'brutal' }, { 'nightmare_dosa_betting_12_1', 'mercy' } })
	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 온도를 올린다.
		local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, parent = user_party_leader, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player'})
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_catch_fire_01')
		local fire_effect = self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(iron_sand_pot.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shake_3d_object, self, iron_sand_pot, 1))
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
		equipping_sfx:Stop()
		wait_for_sec(1)

		yield_return_func(self.fire_effect_extinguish, self, fire_effect, 0.5)

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_58' })
	end

	local merchant = self.get_merchant()

	self.is_saw_introduce_diamond = true

	-- 상인(China_merchant), smile, clap, down, 자자 여러분! 이것이 모든 무도인들이 탐내는 수련용 금강석입니다.

	character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = 'clap' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_17' })

	character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_18' })

	-- 상인, idle, idle, down, 자자! 여러분 시험 삼아 얼마든 쳐보세요!
	character_util.remove_emotion(merchant)
	character_util.remove_anim(merchant)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = 'nightmare_dosa_betting_19' })

	self.introduce_diamond_coroutine = nil

function local_class:interact_merchant()
	local merchant = self.get_merchant()

	if self.introduce_diamond_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.introduce_diamond_coroutine)
		self.introduce_diamond_coroutine = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(merchant)

-- 3D 오브젝트라 직접 흔들어줬음
function local_class:shake_3d_object(fo, duration, magnitude)
	magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(magnitude, 1)

	local origin_pos = fo.Position
	local pos_list = {
		vector(-0.02, 0, 0),
		vector(-0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0),
		vector(0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0.02, 0, 0)
	}

	local cur_idx = 3
	local dif = 1
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		cur_idx = cur_idx + dif
		if cur_idx > 5 then
			cur_idx = 5
			dif = -1
		elseif cur_idx < 1 then
			cur_idx = 1
			dif = 1
		end

		fo.Position = origin_pos + (pos_list[cur_idx] * magnitude)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = origin_pos
end

-- 불 이펙트 서서히 꺼지게
function local_class:fire_effect_extinguish(effect, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local position = effect.transform.position

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)

		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - progress)
		effect.transform.position = position + (vector(0, 0, 0.3) * progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	effect:Dispose()
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:interact_succubus()
	local succubus = self.get_succubus_guide()
	local succubus_2 = self.get_succubus(2)

	self:align_with_ailie(succubus, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 요즘 이상하게 직원들이 무단 결근을 하고 있어요.
	character_util.set_emotion(succubus, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_1', skip = true })

	-- 혹시 사고라도 당한 건 아닐까요?
	character_util.set_anim(succubus, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus, { key = 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_2', skip = true })

	-- 드림 클리닉에 대해 말한다. / 아무 것도 아니다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_2_1', 'mercy' }, { 'nightmare_dungeonkingdom_incubus_2_2', 'brutal' } })
	if choose_result == 2 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus)

		self:restore_ailie()

		return false
	end

	-- 뭐, 뭐라고요?!

	if choose_result == 2 then

	end

function local_class:align_with_ailie(target, dir, duration, type)
	if self.align_ailie then
		local ailie = self.get_ailie()

		local direction = character_util.get_direction(dir)
		local target_is_character = lua_helper.type_compare(target, CS.Oak.Character)
		local target_pos = target_is_character and target.Position or target
		local move_pos = target_pos + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(direction) * (target_is_character and 1.5 or 1)
				+ CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetCWTurn(direction, 3))

		character_util.move_waypoint(ailie, move_pos, 4, false, false, false,
				direction_util.get_opposite(character_util.get_direction(dir)))
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(target, dir, duration, type)
end

	if self.align_ailie then

				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)
		ailie:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end

function local_class:world_cloud_preset(codes, min_delay, max_delay, min_font_size, max_font_size, additional_speed)
	-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
	local code_interval_large = 1.4 / (#codes + 1)
	local code_interval_small = code_interval_large / 4

	-- 평균 시간 계산
	local standard_delay = (min_delay + max_delay) / 2

	-- 홀수, 짝수 시의 시간 간격 저장
	local saved_delay = 0

	for i = 1, #codes do
		-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
		local curY_middle = -0.7 + code_interval_large * i
		local curY_min = curY_middle + code_interval_small
		local curY_max = curY_middle + code_interval_small * 3

		-- 말구름 시작 위치 y값 랜덤으로 설정
		local curX = 1.5
		local curY = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(curY_min, curY_max)

		-- 말구름 폰트 사이즈 랜덤으로 설정
		local cur_font_size = random_util.get_random_int(min_font_size, max_font_size)
		-- 말구름 이동 속도 랜덤으로 설정
		local cur_speed = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.45, 0.55);
		if additional_speed ~= nil then
			cur_speed = cur_speed + additional_speed
		end

		-- 말구름 색상 5개 준비
		local special_color = {CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 0, 255), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 0, 255),
							   CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0, 255, 255), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 179, 222, 255),
							   CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 255, 255)}

		-- 말구름 색상 랜덤으로 설정 (색상 들어갈 확률 5/15)
		local color_rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 15)
		local color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255)

		if color_rand <= 5 then
			color = special_color[color_rand]
		end

		-- 말구름 생성
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.MessyText.SetMessyText(game_string:GetString(codes[i]),
				vector(curX, curY), 0, 9999, cur_font_size, 0, vector(-1, 0), cur_speed, 10, color))

		-- 랜덤으로 대기
		-- index가 짝수 : 현재 딜레이를 저장하고 다음으로 이동
		-- index가 홀수 : 짝수 값에 맞춰서 두 딜레이를 더한 값이 평균이 되도록 설정한 뒤 다음으로 이동
		local cur_delay = (i % 2 == 0) and CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min_delay, max_delay) or 2 * standard_delay - saved_delay

		if i % 2 == 0 then
			saved_delay = cur_delay
		end

		wait_for_sec(cur_delay)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:working_conveyor_belt_update()
	self.is_in_grid = true

	while self.is_in_grid do
		for i = 1, #self.working_conveyor_belt_list do
			local working_conveyor_belt_index = self.working_conveyor_belt_list[i]
			local belt_data = self.belt_table[working_conveyor_belt_index]
			local move_obj = belt_data.move_obj
			local current_marker_index = belt_data.current_marker_index
			local current_marker = belt_data.marker_list[current_marker_index]
			local next_marker = nil

			if current_marker_index < #belt_data.marker_list then
				next_marker = belt_data.marker_list[current_marker_index + 1]
			end

			if move_obj and next_marker then
				local speed = belt_data.speed
				local move_direction = (next_marker.position - current_marker.position).normalized
				local move_vector = move_direction * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local move_distance = move_vector.sqrMagnitude
				local distance = (next_marker.position - move_obj.Position).sqrMagnitude

				if move_vector.magnitude >= distance then
					local a = 0
				end

				if move_distance >= distance then
					move_obj.Position = next_marker.position
					belt_data.current_marker_index = belt_data.current_marker_index + 1

					-- 마지막 마커에 도착했을 때
					if belt_data.current_marker_index >= #belt_data.marker_list then
						local move_obj_type = belt_data.move_obj_type

						if move_obj_type == 'pushable' then
							music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', parent = move_obj, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
							move_obj.Pushable = CS.Oak.UnitPushable()
						elseif move_obj_type == 'holdable' then
							move_obj.Pushable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
						elseif move_obj_type == 'gear' then
							local gear_num = string.sub(move_obj.Name, 17)
							message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'glados_gear_get', gear_num }))
						end
					end
				else
					move_obj.Position = move_obj.Position + move_vector
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

--region util
function local_class:move_waypoint_async(fo, waypoint_list, speed, endtype)
	local waypoint_index = 1

	if not type_util.is_table(waypoint_list) then
		waypoint_list = { waypoint_list }
	end

	self:stop_move_waypoint(fo)
	local req_id = self.move_waypoint_req_id[fo]

	repeat
		local pos = fo.Position
		local move_distance = speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		while #waypoint_list >= waypoint_index do
			local target_pos = waypoint_list[waypoint_index]
			local diff = target_pos - pos

			if diff.magnitude > move_distance then
				pos = pos + diff.normalized * move_distance
				break
			else
				move_distance = move_distance - diff.magnitude
				pos = target_pos
				waypoint_index = waypoint_index + 1

				if waypoint_index > #waypoint_list then
					if endtype == 'loop' then
						waypoint_index = 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		fo.Position = pos

		coroutine.yield()
	until req_id ~= self.move_waypoint_req_id[fo] or #waypoint_list < waypoint_index

	if req_id == self.move_waypoint_req_id[fo] then
		fo.Position = waypoint_list[#waypoint_list]
	end
end

function local_class:move_waypoint(fo, waypoint_list, speed, endtype)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_waypoint_async, self, fo, waypoint_list, speed, endtype))
end

function local_class:stop_move_waypoint(fo)
	if not self.move_waypoint_req_id[fo] then
		self.move_waypoint_req_id[fo] = 0
	end
	self.move_waypoint_req_id[fo] = self.move_waypoint_req_id[fo] + 1
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local mako = self.get_mako()
	local snow_prince = self.get_snow_prince()
	local succubus_1 = self.get_hospital_succubus_1()
	local succubus_2 = self.get_hospital_succubus_2()

	-- 이벤트가 완료된 상태라면 재시작 시...
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
		local favi = self.get_favi()

		character_util.add_listener(oni_girl, self)
		character_util.add_listener(favi, self)

		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_emotion(favi, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_direction(favi, 'right')

		character_util.set_anim(favi, { name = 'shoot', scale = 0.2 })
		character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'idle' })
		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')
	end

	-- 노멀 챕터11의 왕자와 마코 이벤트 클리어 시 - (왕자, 마코 배치), 미 클리어 시 - (다른 NPC 배치)
	local prince_mako_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(203)

	-- quest custom state의 키 값으로 유효한 상태인지 확인, 유효하지 않을때만 custom state값 셋팅
	-- 클리어 유무에 따른 self.prince_mako_quest_complete 값 셋팅
	local is_prince_make_quest_clear = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'prince_mako_quest_clear_new')

	if is_prince_make_quest_clear == -1 then
		if prince_mako_quest_progress ~= nil and prince_mako_quest_progress.IsComplete then
			if prince_mako_quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
				quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'prince_mako_quest_clear_new', 1)
				self.prince_mako_quest_complete = true
			elseif prince_mako_quest_progress.Grade == 1 then
				quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'prince_mako_quest_clear_new', 0)
				self.prince_mako_quest_complete = false
			end
		else
			quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'prince_mako_quest_clear_new', 0)
			self.prince_mako_quest_complete = false
		end
	elseif is_prince_make_quest_clear == 1 then
		self.prince_mako_quest_complete = true
	elseif is_prince_make_quest_clear == 0 then
		self.prince_mako_quest_complete = false
	end

	-- 맨 처음 스테이지 진입 시 203 퀘스트 클리어 유무 체크하여 NPC 배치 및 oneline 대사 변경
	if self.prince_mako_quest_complete then
		stage_util.set_character_active_state('hospital_frozen_patient', 'disabled')

		character_util.add_listener(mako, self)
		character_util.add_listener(snow_prince, self)

		succubus_1.Position = vector(38, 0, 85)
		character_util.set_direction(succubus_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(succubus_1, { name = 'idle' })
		succubus_2.Position = vector(39, 0, 85)
		character_util.set_direction(succubus_2, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(succubus_2, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	else
		stage_util.set_character_active_state('mako', 'disabled')
		stage_util.set_character_active_state('snow_prince', 'disabled')

		local character = get_character('hospital_frozen_patient' )
		character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		-- 얼려진 환자 오브젝트의 캐릭터 스텟UI 지우기
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	character_util.add_listener(succubus_1, self)
	character_util.add_listener(succubus_2, self)
end

end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self:on_interact_event(e) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('oni_girl')) and not self.is_oni_girl_talking then
			self.is_oni_girl_talking = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_oni_girl, self))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_favi, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 서큐버스 1, 2와의 인터렉션

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_succubus_1, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_hospital_succubus_2()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_succubus_2, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mako()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_mako, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_snow_prince()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_snow_prince, self))
		return true
	end

	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'fall_zone' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_send_zone_routine, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'fall_zone' then
		self.send_zone_check = false
		return true
	elseif zone_name == 'fat_elf_zone' then
		self.eat_sound_loop = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:fall_send_zone_routine()
	self.send_zone_check = true
	while self.send_zone_check do
		if user_party.Leader.Position.y <= -1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_player, self))
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end


function local_class:fall_player()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local out_point = field:GetMarker('fall_out_point').position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], out_point + vector(0, 15, 20))
		character_util.set_active_shadow(user_party[i], false)
	end
	camera_util.move_async(out_point,0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, 'linear')

	if self.current_progress ~= self.event_progress.move_elf then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_end, self, out_point))

		wait_for_sec(2)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.4)
		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		return
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { self.fall_event_name }))
	end
end

function local_class:fall_end(out_point)
	local fall_time = 1
	local fall_party_delay = fall_time / user_party.Count

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party = user_party[i]
		character_util.spine_scale(party, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
		character_util.set_position(party, out_point + vector(0, 15, i * 0.2))
		character_util.set_direction(party, 'down')
		character_util.set_active_shadow(party, true)

		-- 일정 시간 동안 자유낙하하는 캐릭터 연출
		local freefall_character = function(character, fall_time, offset_y)
			local curtime = unity_class.time.time
			local falltime = fall_time
			local curpos = character.Position
			local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(falltime, curpos.y, 0)
			offset_y = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_y, 0)

			local shadow_offset_origin = character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition

			while unity_class.time.time - curtime < falltime do
				freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

				local y = curpos.y + dist_y + offset_y
				if y < offset_y then
					y = offset_y
				end
				character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, y, curpos.z), true)
				character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_offset_origin + vector(0, -y, 0)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.jump(character, 0.5, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

			character_util.remove_anim(character)
			character_util.set_position(character, vector(curpos.x, offset_y, curpos.z))
			character.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_offset_origin
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(freefall_character, party, fall_time, 0))

		wait_for_sec(fall_party_delay)
		if i == 0 then
			character_util.set_emotion(party, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_anim(party, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(party, { name = 'get' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_id = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

	for i = 1, 30 do
		local footstool = get_field_object(first_name .. i)
		footstool.transform:GetChild(0).localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 180)
	end

		wall_invisiable.ActiveState = is_active and CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled or CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

-- 사우나 불꽃 이팩트 재생
function local_class:show_sauna_burn_effect()
	-- 불 이팩트 재생할 타일 이름 리스트
	local effect_root_indexs = { 1, 2, 5, 6 }

	local time_passed = 0
	while self.is_in_camera_grid do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 2초 마다 불 이팩트 재생
		if time_passed > 2 then
			time_passed = 0
			for i = 1, #effect_root_indexs do
				for j = 1, 4 do
					local sauna_tile = get_field_object('sauna_tile_' .. effect_root_indexs[i] .. '_' .. j)
					self.get_sauna_effect():Instantiate(sauna_tile.Position)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.banana_item.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	self.banana_item = nil
	wait_for_sec(1)
	coroutine.yield(self:rotate_box(banana_box, -90, 0.5))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	banana_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.get_banana_item = true
end

-- 상자 살짝 들리는 연출
function local_class:rotate_box(box, rotation, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_box_remove_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_rotation = box.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.x

	local start_y = box.Transform.localPosition.y
	local end_y

	if rotation > 0 then
		end_y = 0.5
	else
		end_y = 0
	end

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_rotation = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_rotation, rotation, duration)

		box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(cur_rotation, 0, 0))

		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_y, end_y - start_y, duration)

		box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, cur_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(start_rotation + rotation, 0, 0))
	box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, end_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)
end

		self.banana_item = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_id = nil

function local_class:section_setting()
	if self.quest_progress == nil then return end

	local disable_characters = function(names)
		for _, name in ipairs(names) do
			local character = get_character(name)
			character.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	if stage.Name == self.main_stage_1_name then
		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			disable_characters({ 'sohee', 'lavi', 'favi', 'terrify_ghost_1', 'terrify_ghost_2', 'lead_student'})
		else
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 0 or self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.time_travel_arrival_key) == 1 then
				local sohee = get_character('sohee')
				party_util.add_member(sohee)
			end

			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 0 then
				disable_characters({ 'lavi', 'favi', 'terrify_ghost_1', 'terrify_ghost_2', 'lead_student' })
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_2_name then

		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 then
			local sohee = get_character('sohee')
			party_util.add_member(sohee)
		end

		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			local names = {
				'sohee',
				'lavi',
				'favi',
				'founder',
				'student_1',
				'student_2',
				'student_3',
				'student_4',
				'attack_ghost_1',
				'attack_ghost_2'
			}
			for i = 1, 21 do
				names[#names + 1] = 'founder_room_ghost_' .. i
			end
			disable_characters(names)
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 1 then
			local names = {
				'lavi',
				'favi',
				'founder',
				'student_1',
				'student_2',
				'student_3',
				'student_4',
				'attack_ghost_1',
				'attack_ghost_2'
			}
			for i = 1, 21 do
				names[#names + 1] = 'founder_room_ghost_' .. i
			end
			disable_characters(names)
		end

		-- 배경 그림들 레벨 UI 제거
		local landscapes = {
			get_character('landscape_1'),
			get_character('landscape_2'),
			get_character('landscape_3')
		}
		for _, landscape in ipairs(landscapes) do
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(landscape, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		-- 뒷 액자배경과 겹치지않게 창립자한테 오프셋 부여
		local founder = get_character('founder')
		founder.Position = founder.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.01
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_3_name then
		if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			disable_characters({ 'sohee', 'lavi', 'favi' })
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 2 then
			self:sohee_lavi_favi_add_to_party()
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_4_name then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 4 then
			self:sohee_lavi_favi_add_to_party()
		elseif not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 4 then
			party_util.add_member(get_character('sohee'))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_library_3'))
		else
			local names = {
				'race_beast',
				'battle_beast',
				'assault_beast',
				'sohee',
				'lavi',
				'favi',
			}
			disable_characters(names)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('door_library_3'))
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_5_name then
		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 5 then
			self:sohee_lavi_favi_add_to_party()
		else
			disable_characters({ 'lavi', 'favi', 'sohee' })
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_6_name then
		if not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 6 then
			self:sohee_lavi_favi_add_to_party()
		else
			local disable_npcs = {
				get_character('sohee'),
				get_character('lavi'),
				get_character('favi'),
				get_character('boss_portrait_center')
			}
			for _, npc in ipairs(disable_npcs) do
				npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end

		local left_bg = get_character('boss_portrait_left')
		local right_bg = get_character('boss_portrait_right')

		left_bg.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		right_bg.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

function local_class:preload_time_travel_effects()
	local clock_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_clock')
	local glow_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_glow')

	wait_all({
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPool.WaitUntilLoaded(clock_pool),
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPool.WaitUntilLoaded(glow_pool),
	})
end

function local_class:attach_glow_effect_to(target)
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction))
	return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_glow'):Instantiate(target.Position, rot, target.Transform)
end

function local_class:show_clock_effect()
	local base_offset = unity_class.vector3.back * 10
	local base_target_size = 2.8
	local scale_ratio = stage_camera.Size / base_target_size

	local pooled = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('time_travel_clock'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	pooled.transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform.parent
	pooled.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	pooled.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale_ratio
	pooled.transform.localPosition = base_offset * scale_ratio

	return pooled
end

function local_class:scale_clock_effect_speed(clock, scale)
	if clock == nil then return end

	local comps = clock:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))

	for i = 0, comps.Length - 1 do
		local comp = comps[i]
		local main = comp.main
		main.simulationSpeed = scale
	end
end

function local_class:show_time_travel(scale, wait_time_after_fade, bgm_mute)
	local fade_out_time = 0.15

	if scale == 1.5 or scale == 2 then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_time_effect_01')
	end

	local clock_effect = self:show_clock_effect()
	self:scale_clock_effect_speed(clock_effect, scale)

	wait_for_sec(self.clock_effect_duration / scale - fade_out_time)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.25)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_out_time, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	if bgm_mute == true then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = wait_time_after_fade })
	end

	wait_for_sec(lua_helper.get_or_default(wait_time_after_fade, 1))
end

function local_class:set_scailing_weapon1(character, weapon_name)
	local character_level = character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Level
	local item_base_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName(weapon_name .. '_epic')

	local w = CS.Oak.Weapon.CreateMonsterWeapon(item_base_spec, nil, nil, character_level, nil,
			character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType)

end

return {

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		-- 퀘스트를 받은 이후에는, 오컬트 소녀를 비활성화
		local occult_girl = get_character(self.occult_girl_name)

	local ghostly_thing_name_list = { self.ghostly_book_name, self.ghostly_scale_name, self.ghostly_furball_name }
	local ghostly_thing_item_spec_name_list = { self.ghostly_book_item_name, self.ghostly_scale_item_name, self.ghostly_furball_item_name }
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')

	self.ghostly_thing_item_dict = {}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local target = get_field_object(ghostly_thing_name_list[i])

		-- 퀘스트 진행도에 따라서, 이미 봤던 이벤트의 원혼이 서린 물건은 생성하지 않는다.
		if self.quest_progress == nil or (not self.quest_progress.IsComplete and self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(target.Name) == -1) then
			local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(ghostly_thing_item_spec_name_list[i]).Id

		else

		end
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.listening_item_get_event then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

	self.ghostly_thing_item_dict = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	end

	if self.ghostly_thing_item_dict[target_name] ~= nil then
		self.ghostly_thing_item_dict[target_name]:ConsumeComplete()
		self.ghostly_thing_item_dict[target_name] = nil
	end

function local_class:sns_message(data)
	local id = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'id')
	local key = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'key')
	local text = game_string:GetString(key)

	local follower_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('FollowerData')
	local spec = follower_data:GetSpec(id)

	local target_name = spec.Name
	local portrait_name = spec.PortraitName
	local sns_obj = CS.Oak.SNSMessage.Create(target_name, portrait_name, text)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSEvent.Create(sns_obj))

	local sns_popped = false

	local event_receiver = {}
	event_receiver.on_sns_popped = function(e)
		sns_popped = true
		return false
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_receiver, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent), 'on_sns_popped')

	local time_passed = 0

	while sns_popped == false and time_passed < 1.75 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if sns_popped == false then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSPopEvent.Instance)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_receiver, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent))
	event_receiver = nil
end

function local_class:sns_follow(id)
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.AddSNSCoroutine, id)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local innuit_male = self:get_innuit_male()
	local innuit_female = self:get_innuit_female()
	local innuit_male_2 = self:get_innuit_male_2()
	local desertelf_mad_male = self:get_desertelf_mad_male()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, desertelf_mad_male) then
		if self.is_see_seal then
			-- 오크통을 정확히 밀어 올리는 협응력… 본받아야겠군.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(desertelf_mad_male,
					{ key = self.demonkiss_talk .. 69})
			return
		else
			-- 오늘도 빙판 위 가부좌 12시간… 더 정진해야 한다!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(desertelf_mad_male,
					{ key = self.demonkiss_talk .. 68})
		end
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, innuit_male_2) then
		-- 집들이는 얼어죽을… 무슨 이글루가 바깥보다 추워…!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(innuit_male_2,
				{ key = self.demonkiss_talk .. 70})
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, innuit_male) then
		if not self.is_ending then
			if self.is_barrel_in then
				-- 이, 이건 뭐지? 오크통?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(innuit_male,
						{ key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_demonkiss_innuit_1'})
			else
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
				-- 아니, 이 이글루는 왜 바깥보다 더 추운 거야?!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(innuit_male, { key = self.demonkiss_talk .. 48})
			end
		else
			-- 얼음 탄산 보리차 10년치 공급 계약이라니! 우린 이제 부자야!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(innuit_male,
					{ key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_demonkiss_innuit_3'})
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, innuit_female) then
		if not self.is_ending then
			if self.is_barrel_in then
				-- 오크통이 얼어버렸잖아?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(innuit_female,
						{ key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_demonkiss_innuit_2'})
			else
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
				-- 그러게 다른 업체에 건축 맡기자고 해도!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(innuit_female,
						{ key = self.demonkiss_talk .. 49 })
			end
		else
			-- 얼음장처럼 추운 이글루에 살길 잘했어!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(innuit_female,
					{ key = 'nightmare_snowmountain_demonkiss_innuit_4'})
		end
	end
	return
end

	if e.Zone.Name == self.cold_igloo_zone_name and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject,
			user_party.Leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_cold_igloo, self))
