	local innuit_female = self:get_innuit_female()
	local innuit_male_2 = self:get_innuit_male_2()
	local desertelf_mad_male = self:get_desertelf_mad_male()
	local ending_frozen_barrel_1 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_1()
	local ending_frozen_barrel_2 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_2()
	local ending_frozen_barrel_3 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_3()
	local ending_frozen_barrel_4 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_4()

	ending_frozen_barrel_1.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	ending_frozen_barrel_2.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	ending_frozen_barrel_3.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	ending_frozen_barrel_4.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	character_util.set_position(desertelf_mad_male, vector(-30.5,0,-90.5))
	character_util.set_position(innuit_male_2, vector(-23,0,-56))
	character_util.set_position(innuit_male, vector(-64.5 ,0,-100))
	character_util.set_direction(innuit_male, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(desertelf_mad_male, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(innuit_male_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit_male_2, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit_male, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(desertelf_mad_male, { name = 'meditation', loop = false})
	character_util.shake(innuit_male, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.shake(innuit_male_2, 0.03, 9999)

	character_util.set_position(innuit_female, vector(-62.5 ,0,-100))
	character_util.set_direction(innuit_female, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit_female, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.shake(innuit_female, 0.03, 9999)

	innuit_female.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	innuit_male.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	innuit_male_2.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	desertelf_mad_male.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	local seal = get_field_object('ice_break')
	seal.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.2,0,0.8), vector(1.8, 1, 1.8))
end

function local_class:ending_setting()
	local innuit_male = self:get_innuit_male()
	local innuit_female = self:get_innuit_female()
	local innuit_male_2 = self:get_innuit_male_2()

	local ending_frozen_barrel_1 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_1()
	local ending_frozen_barrel_2 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_2()
	local ending_frozen_barrel_3 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_3()
	local ending_frozen_barrel_4 = self:get_ending_frozen_barrel_4()

	ending_frozen_barrel_1.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	ending_frozen_barrel_2.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	ending_frozen_barrel_3.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	ending_frozen_barrel_4.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	character_util.stop_shake(innuit_male_2)
	character_util.remove_emotion(innuit_male_2)
	character_util.set_position(innuit_male_2,vector(99,0,99))

	character_util.stop_shake(innuit_female)
	character_util.stop_shake(innuit_male)
	character_util.set_direction(innuit_male, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(innuit_male, { name = 'dance' } , { name = 'smile'})

	character_util.set_direction(innuit_female, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(innuit_female, { name = 'success' } , { name = 'smile'})
end

-- 이글루에 들어갔을때
function local_class:enter_cold_igloo()
	self.is_igloo_zone_leave = false
	if not self.is_ending then
		if self.is_barrel_in then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_innuit_surprise, self))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_innuit, self))
		end
	end
	field:Tint('igloo_tint', unity_color({ 0.2, 0.2, 0.4, 1 }), 0)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.show_attack_timer(user_party.Leader, self.igloo_time)

	local time_passed = 0

	while not self.is_igloo_zone_leave do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed > self.igloo_time then
			character_util.hide_attack_timer(user_party.Leader)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.igloo_soft_reset, self))
			wait_for_sec(4)
			field:RemoveTint('igloo_tint', 0)
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.hide_attack_timer(user_party.Leader)
	self.is_barrel_in = false
end

function local_class:igloo_soft_reset()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_drown_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count-1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'dead' , loop = false },
				{ name = 'damaged' })
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local held = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		character_util.clear_holdup_state(user_party.Leader, held)
		character_util.move_to(held, user_party.Leader.Position +
				direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction), 0.3)
	end
	wait_for_sec(2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	party_util.align_party(vector(-25,0,-57), 'right', 0, 'arc')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party.Leader, 'left', 0.3, 0.5)
	for i = 1, user_party.Count-1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:set_innuit_surprise()
	local innuit_male = self.get_innuit_male()
	local innuit_female = self.get_innuit_female()

	character_util.set_direction(innuit_male, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(innuit_female, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit_male, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit_female, { name = 'surprise' })

	character_util.set_direction(innuit_male, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(innuit_female, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit_male, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_emotion(innuit_female, { name = 'scared' })

function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera


	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
				camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
	if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
		self.blizzard.material = nil
		self.blizzard.color = nil
		self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
		self.blizzard.obj = nil
	end

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end

-- 일반적으로 눈보라 사운드는 섹션 내에서 관리하면 되지만 섹션 6 ~ 7의 경우 섹션이 넘어간 뒤에 사운드가 FadeOut 되어야 하기 때문에

	})

function local_class:blizzard_fade_sfx(fade_time)
	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(fade_time)
	end
end

--endregion

--재판 카메라
function local_class:camera_move(target_pos, duration, interpolations, end_target)
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(duration) then
		camera_util.move(target_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = end_target })
		return
	end

	duration = duration * 1.5

	local start_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	start_pos.y = target_pos.y
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	local diff = target_pos - start_pos

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		progress = interpolations(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)

		camera_util.move(start_pos + progress * diff, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if end_target ~= nil then
		camera_util.move(target_pos, 0,
				{ ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = end_target })
	end
end

function local_class:camera_effect(delay)
	if delay == nil then
		delay = 0
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(delay))

	stage_camera:Shake(0.2, 0.25)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.075, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(0.075, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:race_setting()
	if #self.holes == 0 then
		local left = field:GetMarker("player_race_start")
		local right = field:GetMarker("seal_point")
		local center = (left.position + vector(0, 0, 1.5) + right.position) / 2
		local bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, vector(right.position.x - left.position.x, 3, 5))
		local move = unity_class.vector3.zero
		local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bound, move)

		for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
			local v = list[i]
			if v.Name == 'floor_ice_break' then
				table.insert(self.holes, v)
				v.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
				v.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.25, 0, 0.75), vector(2, 1, 2))
			else
				local damaged_behaviour = v.DamagedBehaviour
				if lua_helper.type_compare(damaged_behaviour, CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour) then
					table.insert(self.breakables, v)
				end
			end
		end

		list:Dispose()

		for _, member in ipairs(user_party) do
			table.insert(self.prev_party, member)
		end
	end
end

	local marker = field:GetMarker('seal_point')
	for _, hole in ipairs(self.holes) do
		hole.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		hole.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		hole.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0, 0, 1), vector(1, 1, 1))
	end
	for _, box in ipairs(self.breakables) do
		box.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		local stats = box.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour;
		stats:Heal(stats.MaxHP);
	end
	for i, member in ipairs(self.prev_party) do
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		member.Position = marker.position + vector(-3.5 + i, 0, -3.5)
		character_util.set_direction(member, 'up')
	end

	get_character('penguin_sub_1').Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	get_character('penguin_sub_2').Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

function local_class:on_guild_castle_sit_event(e)
	if e.IsSittingOn then
		-- 스테이트를 CharacterControllerSitState 로 바꿔준다.
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState) then
			local direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(e.Chair.FieldObjectBehaviour.StandUpOffset)
			local priority = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom) + 1
			user_party.Leader:SetLockedDirection(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(direction, priority))

			local sit_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState.Create(user_party.Leader, e.Chair, nil)
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(sit_state))
		end

		-- Behaviour 의 스테이트를 CharacterSitState 로 바꿔준다.
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterSitState) then
			local sit_state = CS.Oak.CharacterSitState.Create(user_party.Leader, e.Chair, nil)
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(sit_state))
		end
	else
		if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerSitState) then
			if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterSitState) then
				local sit_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState

				xlua.private_accessible(typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterSitState))

				if sit_state.sitState == CS.Oak.CharacterSitState.SitState.Sit then
					user_party.Leader:RemoveLockedDirection(user_party.Leader)
				end
			end

			user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:FinishSitState()
		end
	end

	return false
end

	local clock_1 = self.get_clock(1)
	local clock_1_children = clock_1.Transform:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))

	for i = 0, clock_1_children.Length - 1 do
		local animator = clock_1_children[i]
		animator.TimeScale = 0.3
	end

function local_class:sns_message(data)
	local id = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'id')
	local target_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'target_name')
	local portrait_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'portrait_name')
	local key = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'key')
	local text = game_string:GetString(key)

	if id ~= nil then
		local follower_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('FollowerData')
		local spec = follower_data:GetSpec(id)

		target_name = spec.Name
		portrait_name = spec.PortraitName
	end
	local sns_obj = CS.Oak.SNSMessage.Create(target_name, portrait_name, text)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSEvent.Create(sns_obj))

	local sns_popped = false

	local event_receiver = {}
	event_receiver.on_sns_popped = function(e)
		sns_popped = true
		return false
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_receiver, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent), 'on_sns_popped')

	local time_passed = 0

	while sns_popped == false and time_passed < 1.75 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if sns_popped == false then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSPopEvent.Instance)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_receiver, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent))
	event_receiver = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end

    elseif self.quest_progress.Grade == 0 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_telephone_box()) then

            {key = game_string:Format('nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_5', user.Name)})
end

function local_class:fake_rock_burn()
    local fake_rock = self.get_fake_rock()
    fake_rock.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
    local fire_fx = self.get_fire():Instantiate(fake_rock.Position + vector(-0.5, 1, -0.75),
            unity_class.quaternion.identity, fake_rock.Transform)
    fire_fx.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)

    wait_for_sec(self.rock_burn_time)

    local explosion_fx = {}
    local pos_x = -0.8
    local pos_z = -0.1
    for i = 1, 3 do
        explosion_fx[i] = self.get_explosion():Instantiate(fake_rock.Position + vector(pos_x, 0, pos_z))
        pos_x = pos_x + 0.3
        pos_z = pos_z * -1
    end
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_leaf_01')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wood_02')
    explosion_fx[2].transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)
    wait_for_sec(0.1)
    character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
    stage_util.set_fo_active_state('fake_rock', 'disabled')

    quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key, 1)

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:interact_telephone_box()
    local telephone_box = self.get_telephone_box()
    party_util.align_party(telephone_box.Position,
            direction_util.get_opposite(user_party_leader.Direction), 0.5,'arc')

    local leader_origin_pos = user_party_leader.Position
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')
    camera_util.move(telephone_box.Position, 0.75)
    character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, telephone_box.Position, 2, false, 'stop')
    character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))

    local wait = true
    local ans = -1

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
    branches:Add({
        -- 부유성에 전화한다.
        Text = game_string:GetString('nightmare_steampunk_hidden_starpiece_6'),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
        Callback = function()
            wait = false
            ans = 1
        end
    })

    ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(nil, branches)

    while wait do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    local rock_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key)

-- 로봇을 들고 수리공을 만남
function local_class:repair_robot()
	self.is_talking = true

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local repair_teatan = get_character(self.repair_teatan_name)
	local robot = get_character(self.robot_name)

	local pos = repair_teatan.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.right
	user_party:PositionParty(pos, CS.Oak.Direction.Left, 1, CS.Oak.Party.AlignType.Linear)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	-- 들고있던 로봇을 놓은 상태로 함
	robot.Holdable:GetThrownBy(user_party_leader)
	message_system:SendSync(robot, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(user_party_leader))

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'throw' })

	-- 던지는 sfx
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

	-- 로봇 내려놓는 연출
	local current_time = 0
	local fall_time = 0.3
	local start_pos = robot.Position:GetX0z()
	local end_pos = user_party_leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.left

	while current_time <= fall_time do
		current_time = current_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(current_time/fall_time)
		local current_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI / 4 * (1 + 3 * progress)) * 1.5
		local current_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		robot.Position = current_xz + current_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	-- 반가워요. 기사님
	local string_key = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_1'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(repair_teatan, { key = string_key, skip = true })

	-- 혹시 로봇 연료가 필요하신가요?
	string_key = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_2'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(repair_teatan, { key = string_key, skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'nod' })
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	-- 잠시만 기다려 주세요.
	string_key = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_3'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(repair_teatan, { key = string_key, skip = true })

	-- 연료 넣는 sfx 루프 재생
	local filling_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop'
	})

	character_util.set_anim(repair_teatan, { name = 'eat' })
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	-- 연료 넣는 sfx 중지
	filling_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_enhance_light_01')

	local fx_buff_magic_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_BuffMagic_Target')
	fx_buff_magic_pool:Instantiate(robot.Position)
	character_util.remove_anim(repair_teatan)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	-- 연료를 가득 채웠어요. 소중히 사용해주세요.
	string_key = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_4'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(repair_teatan, { key = string_key, skip = true })

	self.is_repaired_robot = true
	self.is_talking = false

	-- 로봇 연료가 필요하면 언제든 말씀해주세요.
	repair_teatan.Interactable.Talk = 'nightmare_teatan_4_teatan_rescue_15'

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

	-- add current musics here
	return total_musics

function local_class:section_setting()
	if stage.Name == self.main_stage_3_name then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			local marian = get_character('marian')
			self:add_to_user_party(marian)
		else
			local disable_npcs = {
				get_character('harvester'),
				get_character('marty_junior'),
				get_character('marty_junior_friend_1'),
				get_character('marty_junior_friend_2'),
				get_character('marty_junior_friend_3'),
				get_character('marian'),
				get_character('damaged_tdf_1'),
				get_character('damaged_tdf_2'),
				get_character('damaged_tdf_3'),
				get_character('damaged_tdf_4'),
				get_character('damaged_tdf_5'),
			}
			for _, npc in ipairs(disable_npcs) do
				if npc ~= nil then
					npc:RemoveEmotion()
					npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_2_name then
		local marian = get_character('marian')

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			self:add_to_user_party(marian)
		else
			marian.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_1_name then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 then
			local disable_npcs = {
				get_character('marty_junior_friend_1'),
				get_character('marty_junior_friend_2'),
				get_character('marty_junior_friend_3'),
				get_character('pc_teatan'),
				get_character('marian'),
				get_character('tdf_zaco_1'),
				get_character('tdf_zaco_2')
			}
			for _, npc in ipairs(disable_npcs) do
				if npc ~= nil then
					npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end
			end
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_5_name then
		local marian = get_character('marian')

		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			marian:RemoveEmotion()
			marian:RemoveAnimation()
			marian.Interactable.Talk = ''
			self:add_to_user_party(marian)
		elseif self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			marian.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	elseif stage.Name == self.main_stage_6_name then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
			local marian = get_character('robot_marian')
			self:add_to_user_party(marian)

			-- 인베이더 사령관 등장 이벤트를 이미 봤다면 마티 주니어를 파티로 넣어주기
			if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.commander_event_save_key) == 1 then
				local junior = get_character('robot_marty_junior')
				self:add_to_user_party(junior)
			end
		else
			local disable_characters = {
				get_character('boss_invader'),
				get_character('robot_marian'),
				get_character('robot_marty_junior'),
				get_character('marian'),
				get_character('marty_junior'),
				get_character('fake_teatan')
			}

			for i = 1, 12 do
				disable_characters[#disable_characters + 1] = get_character('robot_teatan_' .. i)
			end

			for i = 1, 14 do
				disable_characters[#disable_characters + 1] = get_character('invader_audience_'.. i)
			end

			for i = 1, 8 do
				disable_characters[#disable_characters + 1] = get_character('boss_battle1_'.. i)
			end

			for i = 1, 3 do
				disable_characters[#disable_characters + 1] = get_character('boss_1_' .. i)
			end

			for _, character in ipairs(disable_characters) do
				character.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_to_user_party(target)
	target.Position = user_party[user_party.Count - 1].Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(target, user_party, true)
end

function local_class:shoot_missile(start_pos, end_pos, duration, args)

	local dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local rot = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, dir)
	local missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_IronMissile_Proj'):Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)
	local use_unscaledtime = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'use_unscaledtime', false)
	local hit_callback = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'callback', nil)

	-- 미사일 발사 sfx 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_missile_launch_01', play_pos = start_pos, type_priority = 'default'
	})

	local tp = 0
	while (tp < duration) do
		local progress = tp / duration

		missile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		if use_unscaledtime == true then
			tp = tp + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
		else
			tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	missile:Dispose()

	-- 미사일 폭발 위치에 가장 낮은 우선순위로 폭발 sfx 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = end_pos, type_priority = 'default'
	})

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_IronMissile_Explosion'):Instantiate(end_pos)

	if hit_callback ~= nil then
		hit_callback()
	end
end

return {

		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end

function local_class:move_target_bezier_curve(transform, spline_list, cycle)
	local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()

	local curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear

	if #spline_list == 3 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
	elseif #spline_list == 4 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
	end

	local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 1, #spline_list do
		list:Add(spline_list[i])
	end

	calculator:Add(list, cycle, curve_type)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < cycle do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local cur_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

		calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition

		transform.position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)
	-- CS Controller 로 OnEvent 를 받을수 있다.
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = scene()
	self.racing_won = false
	self.racing_finished = false
	self.racing_on = false

	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil

	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.PreLoad()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	--필요한 함수들
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.oni_girl = get_character('onigirl')
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource_routine, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local quest_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('QuestData')
	self.quest_spec = quest_data:GetQuest(self.quest_id)
	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	self.scene:add_callback('BackupAndMuteStageMusic', { controller = self, func = self.backup_and_mute_stage_music } )
	self.scene:add_callback('OpenDoorWithFocusCamera', { controller = self, func = self.open_door_with_focus_camera } )
	self.scene:add_callback('PlayRaceBgm', { controller = self, func = self.play_race_bgm } )

	if CS.Oak.UserProgress.Instance:ClearedQuest(self.quest_spec.QuestId) then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl"))
		self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	end

	self.scene:setting()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end
----------------------------------------------------------------

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target
	local inner_progress = 0
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then inner_progress = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress end
	local initiated = false
	local cm = coroutine_manager

	if target ~= self.oni_girl then return end

	if self.quest_progress == nil then
		self.quest_progress = CS.Oak.QuestProgress(self.quest_spec, 0, -1)
		initiated = true
	end

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false and self.racing_finished == false then
		if initiated then
			cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
		else
			cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.race_start, self))
		end
	elseif self.racing_finished then
		if self.racing_won then
			cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))
		else
			cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
		end
		self.racing_finished = false;
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.oni_girl, { key = 'onigirl_26' })
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	if self.quest_progress == nil or self.quest_progress.Grade < 0 then
		CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
	end
end

function local_class:quest_open()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide();

	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirl_1', skip = true})
	self.scene:quest_open()
	self:race_start(true)
end

function local_class:race_start(noAlign)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

	if noAlign == false or noAlign == nil then
		character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")
	else
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	end

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_progress)

	if accepted then
		if CS.Oak.UserProgress.Instance:IsQuestActive(self.quest_id) == false then
			coroutine.yield(quest_util.start_quest(self.quest_progress))
		end

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent())
	else
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestDeclineEvent())
		CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		return
	end

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	self.scene:race_start()

	self.racing_on = true
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	local race_start = stage.Field:GetMarker('race_start').position
	local race_end = stage.Field:GetMarker('race_end').position
	local won = false

	while true do
		if user_party_leader.Position.x < race_start.x - 1 then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
			character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, 'left')

			camera_util.move(self.oni_girl.Position, 1)

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

			character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirl_10', skip = true})
			self:stop_race_bgm()

			coroutine.yield(self:lose())

			break
		end

		if won == false and user_party_leader.Position.x >= race_end.x then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

			self:stop_race_bgm()
			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)
			won = true
		end

		if self.oni_girl.Position.x >= race_end.x then
			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)

			if won == false then
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, { name = 'victory_extra'})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, { name = 'doyagao'})
			else
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, { name = 'seat'})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, { name = 'tired'})
			end
			CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)
			self.racing_on = false
			self.racing_won = won
			self.racing_finished = true
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:stop_race_bgm()
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.oni_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
end

function local_class:win_race()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "right")

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:win_race())

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self, 0))

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
end

function local_class:lose_race()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "right")

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:player_lose())

	coroutine.yield(self:lose())
end

function local_class:lose()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	self.racing_on = false

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:lose_race())

	self.oni_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	self.oni_girl:RemoveEmotion()
	CS.Oak.QuestIcon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:backup_and_mute_stage_music()
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName
	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState

	if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare or
			music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
		self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	end

function local_class:open_door_with_focus_camera()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl", false))

function local_class:play_race_bgm()

	if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then

local local_class = newclass('OniGirlRacingCafeController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = OniGirlRacingCafe @
		Comment = 카페 2스테이지 도깨비 소녀 달리기 퀘스트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	-- npc 이름
	self.guard_name = 'oni_girl_guard_'

	-- 그리드 이름
	self.event_grid_name = 'oni_girl_grid'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.guard_start_waypoint_name = 'guard_start_waypoint_'
	self.guard_end_waypoint_name = 'guard_end_waypoint_'

	-- 가드 수
	self.move_guard_count = 10
	self.total_guard_count = 16

	-- 가드가 멈출 건지
	self.stop_move_guard = {}

	-- 가드가 충동 액션이 끝났는지
	self.end_crash_action = {}

	-- 가드의 이동 프로그레스
	self.guard_current_progress = {}
	self.guard_progress_enum = {
		-- 시작 지점으로 이동 중
		move_start_waypoint = 1,
		-- 끝 지점으로 이동 중
		move_end_waypoint = 2,
	}

	-- 이벤트 그리드 안으로 들어왔는지
	self.in_grid = false
end

function local_class:dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_resource()

end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingCafePreSection')
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()

		quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingCafeSection1')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingCafePostSection')
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	-- 가드들 초기 세팅
	for i = 1, self.total_guard_count do
		local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. i)

		guard.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		guard.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		if i <= self.move_guard_count then
			local marker = field:GetMarker(self.guard_start_waypoint_name .. i).position
			guard.Position = marker

			self.stop_move_guard[guard] = true
			self.end_crash_action[guard] = true
			self.guard_current_progress[guard] = self.guard_progress_enum.move_start_waypoint
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

-- CameraGridEnterEvent
function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.event_grid_name) then
		self.in_grid = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_crash_routine, self))

		for i = 1, self.move_guard_count do
			local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. i)
			self.stop_move_guard[guard] = false
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_move_routine, self, i))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- CameraGridLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.event_grid_name) then
		self.in_grid = false

		for i = 1, self.move_guard_count do
			local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. i)
			self.stop_move_guard[guard] = true
			character_util.stop(guard)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 플레이어와 가드 충돌 체크 루틴
function local_class:check_crash_routine()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local guards = {}
	for i = 1, self.total_guard_count do
		local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. i)
		table.insert(guards, guard)
	end

	while self.in_grid do
		for k, v in pairs(guards) do
			if CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(leader.Bounds, v.Bounds) then
				if leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stunned then

					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')

					-- npc 이동 정지
					character_util.stop(v)
					self.stop_move_guard[v] = true

					-- 플레이어 넉백 방향
					local player_knock_back_dir =
					direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(leader.Position - v.Position))

					-- 플레이어 넉백
					local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
						'linear', true, player_knock_back_dir, nil, nil,
						nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
						CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

					command_util.publish_knock_back(leader.Owner, leader, knock_back_info, leader.Position)

					-- npc 충돌 처리
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(v)
					character_util.spine_deviate_local(
						v, -0.25 * player_knock_back_dir, 0.12, 0.12)

					if self.end_crash_action[v] then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.crash_guard_action, self, v, k, player_knock_back_dir))
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 충돌 후 가드들 행동
function local_class:crash_guard_action(guard, index, player_knock_back_dir)
	self.end_crash_action[guard] = false

	-- 가만히 서있는 가드인지
	local standing_guard = false

	-- 가만히 서있는 가드들
	for i = 11, self.total_guard_count do
		if i == index then
			standing_guard = true
		end
	end

	-- npc 넉백 (npc 이동 방향에서만 넉백 됨)
	-- 넉백 이동에 벽이 있으면 넉백 되지 않음
	if not standing_guard then
		local guard_knock_back_dir = -1 * player_knock_back_dir

		local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(guard.Bounds, 0.4 * guard_knock_back_dir)
		local is_wall = false

		-- 벽이 있는지 체크
		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]
			if obj.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
				is_wall = true
				break
			end
		end

		obj_list:Dispose()

		-- npc 넉백 실행
		local guard_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(guard.Direction)
		if not is_wall and player_knock_back_dir == guard_dir or player_knock_back_dir == -1 * guard_dir then
			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				'linear', true, guard_knock_back_dir, nil, nil,
				nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
				CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

			command_util.publish_knock_back(guard.Owner, guard, knock_back_info, guard.Position)
		end
	end

	-- 꺄악! 내 폰!!!
	-- 눈 똑바로 뜨고 다녀!
	-- 으아악!
	local string_key = { 'cafe_oni_girl_racing_9', 'cafe_oni_girl_racing_10', 'cafe_oni_girl_racing_11' }
	local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, { key = string_key[random_index] })

	self.end_crash_action[guard] = true
	self.stop_move_guard[guard] = false

	-- 움직이는 가드들
	if not standing_guard then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_move_routine, self, index))
	end
end

-- 카메라 그리드에 들어왔을 때만 움직이는 루틴
function local_class:guard_move_routine(index)
	local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. index)

	local guard_speed = 4

	-- 시작 지점, 끝 지점
	local start_marker = field:GetMarker(self.guard_start_waypoint_name .. index).position
	local end_marker = field:GetMarker(self.guard_end_waypoint_name .. index).position

	-- 플레이어가 그리드에서 나가거나 충돌이 생기면 멈춤
	while not self.stop_move_guard[guard] do
		-- 시작 지점으로 이동
		if self.guard_current_progress[guard] == self.guard_progress_enum.move_start_waypoint then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard, start_marker, guard_speed)
		end

		if self.stop_move_guard[guard] then
			self.guard_current_progress[guard] = self.guard_progress_enum.move_start_waypoint
			return
		else
			self.guard_current_progress[guard] = self.guard_progress_enum.move_end_waypoint
		end

		-- 끝 지점으로 이동
		if self.guard_current_progress[guard] == self.guard_progress_enum.move_end_waypoint then
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(guard, end_marker, guard_speed)
		end

		if self.stop_move_guard[guard] then
			self.guard_current_progress[guard] = self.guard_progress_enum.move_end_waypoint
			return
		else
			self.guard_current_progress[guard] = self.guard_progress_enum.move_start_waypoint
		end
	end
end

-- 경기 전 가드들 세팅
function local_class:race_guard_setting()
	local guards = {}
	for i = 1, self.move_guard_count do
		local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. i)
		table.insert(guards, guard)
	end

	for _, guard in pairs(guards) do
		self.stop_move_guard[guard] = true
		character_util.stop(guard)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	for k, guard in pairs(guards) do
		local marker = field:GetMarker(self.guard_start_waypoint_name .. k).position
		guard.Position = marker

		self.stop_move_guard[guard] = false
		self.guard_current_progress[guard] = self.guard_progress_enum.move_start_waypoint

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guard_move_routine, self, k))
	end
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

function local_class:get_musics()
	local total_musics = {}
	-- add current musics here
	return total_musics
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = OniGirlRacingDesert @
		Comment = 사막 챕터의 도깨비 소녀 달리기 퀘스트 @
]]

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)
	-- CS Controller 로 OnEvent 를 받을수 있다.
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = scene()

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	-- pre story section 은 여기서 읽는다
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingDesertPreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingDesertSection1')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingDesertPostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	self.scene:add_callback('BackupAndMuteStageMusic', { controller = self, func = self.backup_and_mute_stage_music })
	self.scene:add_callback('PlayRaceBgm', { controller = self, func = self.play_raceBgm })

	self.scene:setting()
end

function local_class:backup_and_mute_stage_music()
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName
	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState

	if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare or
			music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
		self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	end

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)
end

function local_class:play_raceBgm()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_gun_shoot_01")
	music_player:PlayStageMusic('bgm_lana', CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0)
end

function local_class:stop_race_bgm()
	if music_player.CurrentStageMusicName ~= "bgm_lana" then
		return
	end

	if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	else
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_state)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:exclusive_on_setting(fade)
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then return end

	-- FIXED : [PS-9855] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	local oni_girl = get_character('oni_girl')

	quest_icon_util.remove(oni_girl)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.cs_controller)

	if not fade then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(oni_girl, 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	else
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(oni_girl, 0, 0)
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(oni_girl, 'disabled')
end

--- Exclusive Off 세팅
function local_class:exclusive_off_setting(fade)
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then return end

	-- FIXED : [PS-9855] ExclusiveQuestEvent 타이밍 이슈로 인해 캐릭터가 꺼져있는 이슈 조치
	self.current_request_id = self.current_request_id + 1
	local request_id = self.current_request_id

	local oni_girl = get_character('oni_girl')

	character_util.set_active_state(oni_girl, 'enabled')

	if not fade then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(oni_girl, 1, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	else
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(oni_girl, 1, 0)
	end

	-- 현재 요청 id와 다른 경우 루틴 생략
	if request_id ~= self.current_request_id then
		return
	end

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl)
	character_util.add_listener(oni_girl, self.cs_controller)
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	-- 상태 변수
	self.racing_won = false
	self.racing_finished = false
	self.racing_on = false

	-- 경기 종료 이후 bgm을 복구하기 위한 변수
	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = nil

	-- 레이스 루틴 캐싱
	self.race_coroutine = nil

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource_routine, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	local quest_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('QuestData')
	self.quest_spec = quest_data:GetQuest(self.quest_id)
	self.quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	self.scene:setting()

	self.oni_girl = get_character('onigirl')
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	self.oni_girl_position = self.oni_girl.Position

	-- 이미 클리어한 상태라면 애니메이션을 제거하고 문을 열어줌
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl"))
		character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)
		return
	end

	-- 필요한 콜백 등록
	self.scene:add_callback('OpenDoorWithFocusCamera', { controller = self, func = self.open_door_with_focus_camera } )
	self.scene:add_callback('BackupAndMuteStageMusic', { controller = self, func = self.backup_and_mute_stage_music } )
	self.scene:add_callback('PlayRaceBgm', { controller = self, func = self.play_race_bgm } )

	-- 필요한 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

-- CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent Subscriber
function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local initiated = false
	local cm = coroutine_manager

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.oni_girl) then return end

	if self.quest_progress == nil then
		self.quest_progress = CS.Oak.QuestProgress(self.quest_spec, 0, -1)
		initiated = true
	end

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete == false and self.racing_finished == false then
		if initiated then
			cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_open, self))
		else
			self.race_coroutine = cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.race_start, self))
		end
	elseif self.racing_finished then
		if self.racing_won then
			cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.win_race, self))
		else
			cm:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lose_race, self))
		end
		self.racing_finished = false;
	else
		if CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Get(self.oni_girl.Transform) ~= nil then return end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirl_26'})
	end
end

-- CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent Subscriber
function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	-- 타입 검증
	if e:GetType() ~= typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then return false end
	-- 객체 검증
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end
	-- 조건 검증
	if not self.racing_on then return false end

	-- 레이스 진행 도중 플레이어가 부활했을경우, 라나에게 재도전하는 상태로 초기화
	self:reset_oni_girl()
	self.racing_on = false

	return true
end

-- CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent Subscriber
function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 타입 검증
	if e:GetType() ~= typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then return false end
	-- 객체 검증
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end
	-- 조건 검증
	if not self.racing_on then return false end

	-- 이 시점에서 레이스 루틴은 종료시키지만 racingOn은 부활하면 false로 바꿔준다.
	-- 이때 raceOn을 false로 바꾸면 레이스도중에 부활한건지를 알수없기 떄문
	stop_coroutine(self.race_coroutine)

	local vector_util = CS.VectorExtensions
	local diff = vector_util.GetX0z(user_party_leader.Position - self.oni_girl.Position)
	local dir = vector_util.ToDirection(diff)

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, dir)

	-- 레이스 진행도중에 플레이어가 죽었을경우 곧 GameOver Bgm이 나오기때문에 강제로 BgmState를 Field로 바꾸어 꼬임을 방지.
	-- GameOverUI 리소스 로드가 길어질 경우 BgmState가 꼬이지 않도록 임시로 바꿔준 필드 Bgm이 잠시동안 들릴 수 있다.
	-- 따라서, volume을 0으로 재생하여 들리지 않도록 방지.
	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, nil, 0)

	return true
end

function local_class:quest_open()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "right")

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirlracing_magic_1', skip = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirlracing_magic_2', skip = true})

	local wait_for_branch = true
	local afraid = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.TalkBranch)
	local tb = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	tb.Text = game_string:GetString('bt_yes')
	tb.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal
	tb.Callback = function()
		afraid = true
		wait_for_branch = false
	end
	branches:Add(tb)

	tb.Text = game_string:GetString('bt_no')
	tb.Callback = function()
		afraid = false
		wait_for_branch = false
	end
	branches:Add(tb)

	local acs = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	acs.Branchs = branches
	acs.Talker = self.oni_girl

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, acs)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if afraid == true then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirlracing_magic_3', skip = true})
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirlracing_magic_4', skip = true})
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = 'doyagao'})

	self.scene:quest_open()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	self.race_coroutine = util.cs_generator(self.race_start, self, true)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.race_coroutine)
end

function local_class:race_start(noAlign)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

	if noAlign == false or noAlign == nil then
		character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, 'right')
	else
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	end

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_progress, false)

	if accepted then
		if CS.Oak.UserProgress.Instance:IsQuestActive(self.quest_id) == false then
			coroutine.yield(quest_util.start_quest(self.quest_progress))
		end

		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent())
	else
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestDeclineEvent())
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		return
	end

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:race_start())

	self.racing_on = true
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	local race_start = stage.Field:GetMarker('race_start').position
	local race_end = stage.Field:GetMarker('race_end').position
	local won = false

	while true do
		-- 해당 부분은 클리어 후에 있는 해당 타일맵의 숨겨진 문을 부수고 나갈때 경주 포기로 체크 하기 위함
		if user_party_leader.Position.x > race_start.x + 1 or user_party.Position.z > 98 then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)
			character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, 'left')

			camera_util.move_async(self.oni_girl.Position, 1)

			character_util.jump(self.oni_girl, 0.2, 0.3)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.oni_girl, {key = 'onigirl_10', skip = true})

			-- 경기장 이탈시의 BGM 처리
			self:stop_race_bgm()

			coroutine.yield(self:lose())

			user_party:ResetControllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()

			break
		end

		if won == false and user_party_leader.Position.x <= race_end.x then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

			-- 승리시의 BGM 처리
			self:stop_race_bgm()
			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)
			won = true
		end

		if self.oni_girl.Position.x <= race_end.x then
			character_util.stop(self.oni_girl)

			if won == false then
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, { name = 'victory_extra'})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, { name = 'doyagao'})
			else
				character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, { name = 'seat'})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, { name = 'tired'})
			end
			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.oni_girl)
			self.racing_on = false
			self.racing_won = won
			self.racing_finished = true
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 라나가 먼저 도착한 경우의 처리
	self:stop_race_bgm()
	self.oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	race_coroutine = nil
end

function local_class:win_race()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, "left")

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:win_race())

	quest_util.complete_quest(self, 0)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:lose_race()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.align_party(self.oni_girl, 'left')

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:player_lose())

	coroutine.yield(self:lose())

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:lose()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.oni_girl)

	self.racing_on = false

	self.scene:lose_race()

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.oni_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.oni_girl)

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
end

function local_class:open_door_with_focus_camera()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create("onigirl", false))
	camera_util.move(self.oni_girl.Position + vector(-5, 0, -4), 1)
end

function local_class:reset_oni_girl()
	character_util.set_position(self.oni_girl, self.oni_girl_position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.oni_girl, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.oni_girl, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(self.oni_girl, {name= 'attack'})

	self.oni_girl.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	self.oni_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.oni_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.oni_girl)
end

-- 레이스 전 Muted 상태로 BGM을 바꾸기 전에 기존 BGM 백업하는 과정
function local_class:backup_and_mute_stage_music()
	self.prev_stage_bgm_name = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName
	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState

	if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare or
		music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
		self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	end

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 재생
function local_class:play_race_bgm()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_gun_shoot_01")
	music_player:PlayStageMusic("bgm_lana", CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0)
end

-- 레이싱 BGM 중지 후 기존 BGM으로 복구
function local_class:stop_race_bgm()
	-- 이미 BGM이 중지되었다면 리턴
	if music_player.CurrentStageMusicName ~= "bgm_lana" then
		return
	end

	if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	else
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_state)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

	if self.race_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.race_coroutine)
		self.race_coroutine = nil
	end

	if self.oni_girl ~= nil then
		if self.oni_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.oni_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		end
		self.oni_girl = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.scene = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, scene)

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	-- npc 이름

	self.racing_train_name = 'onigirl_racing_train'

	-- 기믹 이름
	self.rock_name = 'onigirl_racing_rock_'
	self.purple_coin_name = 'purple_coin_'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.destroy_rock_zone_name = 'onigirl_destroy_rock_'
	self.get_purple_coin_zone_name = 'onigirl_get_purple_coin_'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.train_pos_name = 'onigirl_train_pos_'

	self.train_move_progress = 1

	-- 바위 장애물 개수
	self.rock_count = 2
	-- 퍼플 코인 개수
	self.purple_coin_count = 5

	-- 열차 스피드
	self.train_speed = 13

	-- 열차 이동 분기 마커 개수
	self.train_way_point_count = {
		{ 0, 2 },
		{ 4, 2 },
		{ 2, 2 },
		{ 2, 1 }
	}

		self.current_section = nil
	end

		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.touch_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.train_way_point_count do
		self.train_way_point_count[i] = nil
	end
	self.train_way_point_count = nil

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	local racing_train = get_character(self.racing_train_name)

	for i = 1, self.rock_count do
		if zone_name == self.destroy_rock_zone_name .. i then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, racing_train) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.destroy_rock_event, self, i))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.purple_coin_count do
		if zone_name == self.get_purple_coin_zone_name .. i then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, racing_train) then
				local purple_coin = get_field_object(self.purple_coin_name .. i)
				if purple_coin.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
					message_system:Send(purple_coin, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

	return false

-- 열차 이동
function local_class:train_move()
	local progress = self.train_move_progress

	local racing_train = get_character(self.racing_train_name)

	character_util.set_anim(racing_train, { name = 'walk' })

	self.train_move_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '01_train_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 0.5, fade_out_time = 0.5 })

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.train_pos_name .. progress .. '_' .. 1).position
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(racing_train, marker, self.train_speed)

	if racing_train.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_direction(racing_train, 'down')
	end

	self.train_move_sound:Stop()

	local swipe_enum = {
		left = 1,
		right = 2,
		up = 3
	}

	local swipe_result
	local swipe_dir

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
				swipe_result = swipe_enum.left
				swipe_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				swipe_result = swipe_enum.right
				swipe_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
				swipe_result = swipe_enum.up
				swipe_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 튜토리얼 QTE 터치 이벤트
	if progress == 1 then
		local tutorial_swipe = { 'right', 'up', 'left' }
		local tutorial_result = { swipe_enum.right, swipe_enum.up, swipe_enum.left }

		for i = 1, 3 do
			message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_tap_guide_01')

			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(tutorial_swipe[i])

			while swipe_result ~= tutorial_result[i] do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)

			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

			marker = field:GetMarker(self.train_pos_name .. progress .. '_' .. 2 .. '_' .. i).position

			if i == 3 then
				marker = field:GetMarker(self.train_pos_name .. progress .. '_' .. 2).position
			end

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(racing_train, marker, self.train_speed)

			if racing_train.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
				character_util.set_direction(racing_train, 'down')
			end
		end
		-- 터치 제한 구역 해제 (튜토리얼 종료 후 터치 이벤트 대응)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))
		message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

		while swipe_result ~= swipe_enum.up do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		self.train_move_progress = self.train_move_progress + 1

		-- 터치 제한 구역 설정
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))
		return
	end

	-- 터치 제한 구역 해제
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))

	-- 튜토리얼 이후 터치 이벤트
	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	while swipe_result == nil or swipe_result == swipe_enum.up do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- 열차 경로
	local train_way_point = {}

	for i = 1, self.train_way_point_count[progress][swipe_result] do
		marker = field:GetMarker(self.train_pos_name .. progress .. '_' .. swipe_result .. '_' .. i).position
		table.insert(train_way_point, marker)
	end
	table.insert(train_way_point, field:GetMarker(self.train_pos_name .. progress .. '_' .. 2).position)

	for i = 1, #train_way_point do
		local move_end = false
		local move_train = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			self.train_move_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_train_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 0.5, fade_out_time = 0.5 })

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(racing_train, train_way_point[i], self.train_speed)

			self.train_move_sound:Stop()

			move_end = true
		end))

		while not move_end do
			if self.crash_rock then
				move_end = true
				move_train = nil
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.crash_rock then
			self.crash_rock = false
			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(racing_train, train_way_point[i], self.train_speed)
		end

		local success_dir
		if i == #train_way_point then
			-- 마지막 지점은 위로 고정
			success_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		else
			success_dir = vector_util.to_direction(train_way_point[i + 1] - train_way_point[i])
		end

		if racing_train.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			character_util.set_direction(racing_train, 'down')
		end

		-- 코너마다 터치 이벤트
		message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

		while swipe_dir ~= success_dir do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	-- 터치 제한 구역 설정
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))

	self.train_move_progress = self.train_move_progress + 1
end

-- 기차와 바위 충돌 이벤트
function local_class:destroy_rock_event(index)
	local racing_train = get_character(self.racing_train_name)

	local rock = get_field_object(self.rock_name .. index)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
	damage_info.sender = racing_train
	damage_info.target = rock
	damage_info.damage = 100

	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	self.train_move_sound:Stop()

	-- 열차 이동 멈춤
	character_util.stop(racing_train)

	--열차 피격 연출
	local deviation = 3 * direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(racing_train.Position - rock.Position))
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(racing_train, deviation, 0.5, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(racing_train)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(racing_train)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

	self.crash_rock = true
end

-- 경기 종료 공통 세팅
function local_class:end_game_setting()
	local racing_train = get_character(self.racing_train_name)
	local oni_girl = get_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.train_move_progress = 1

	-- 페이드 인 아웃 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.stop(racing_train)
	racing_train.Position = field:GetMarker('train_pos').position
	character_util.set_direction(racing_train, 'up')

	oni_girl.Position = field:GetMarker('onigirl_pos').position

	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')

	for i = 1, self.rock_count do
		local rock = get_field_object(self.rock_name .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(rock, 'enabled')
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move(leader.Position, 0, { end_target = leader })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:get_musics()
	local total_musics = {}
	-- add current musics here
	return total_musics
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	-- 기본 이벤트 섹션들 로드를 여기서 처리
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'OniGirlRacingTeatansSection1')

end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.setting_section, self))
end

function local_class:setting_section()
	self.scene:add_callback('BackupAndMuteStageMusic', {controller = self,
	                                                    func = self.backup_and_mute_stage_music } )
	self.scene:add_callback('PlayRaceBgm', { controller = self, func = self.play_race_bgm } )

	coroutine.yield(self.scene:setting())
end

function local_class:backup_and_mute_stage_music()
	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = music_player.StageBgmState
	self.prev_state_bgm_name = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName

	if music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Fanfare or
			music_player.StageBgmState == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.NewCharacterTheatre then
		self.prev_stage_bgm_state = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	end

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)
end

function local_class:play_race_bgm()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.sfx_gun_shot_name)
	music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.bgm_lana_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event, 0)
end

function local_class:stop_race_bgm()
	if music_player.CurrentStageMusicName ~= self.bgm_lana_name then
		return
	end

	if self.prev_stage_bgm_state == CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event then
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_state_bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Event)
	else
		music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_bgm_state)
	end
end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)

	return false
end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.prev_stage_bgm_state = nil
	self.prev_state_bgm_name = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end


	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
